subject: general
question: Which of the following is a correct statement regarding violations in basketball?

options.text: A player may stay in the restricted area for 5 seconds.
A team must shoot the ball within 8 seconds of play.
A dribble ends when both hands touch the ball once.
A player remains in play while standing on sideline.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A dribble ends when both hands touch the ball once.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In basketball, a dribble ends when a player uses both hands to touch the ball simultaneously or when the ball comes to rest in one or both hands.
 
• This rule is enforced to maintain the flow of the game and prevent unfair advantages that could arise from manipulating the ball with both hands.
 
• Once a dribble ends, the player cannot resume dribbling the ball; doing so constitutes a "double dribble" violation.
 
• After the dribble ends, the player must either pass the ball to a teammate or attempt a shot.
 
• The dribble is a fundamental basketball skill used to advance the ball, evade defenders, or create opportunities for passing and shooting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Skills**

 
 
• Dribbling: Bouncing the ball continuously with one hand while moving; essential for ball control and advancing.
 
• Passing: Moving the ball to teammates using chest, bounce, or overhead passes to create scoring chances.
 
• Shooting: Throwing the ball into the basket (layups, jump shots, free throws).
 
• Defense: Preventing the opponent from scoring through man-to-man, zone, or blocking shots.
 
• Rebounding: Gaining possession of missed shots.
